title: Proof-Valid Serving and Benchmarking for Approximate LLM Caches under Premise Erasure — Experiment Artifact
description: Complete experimental programs, data, and result artifacts for the paper 'Proof-Valid Serving and Benchmarking for Approximate LLM Caches under Premise Erasure' (J. Xu), submitted to Knowledge and Information Systems. Includes all run scripts, canonical result JSONs, human annotation artifacts, rebuilt 2026 Wikipedia/Wikidata snapshot inputs, and figure-replot scripts. Companion theory preprint: arXiv:2608.11782.
